title: Why aren't smart people happier? (2022)
summary: This article from David B. clear's Experimental History explores the psychological paradox of why higher intelligence doesn't correlate with greater happiness, examining research on overthinking, awareness of problems, and the psychological burdens of analytical minds.
problem_solved: Explores the counterintuitive relationship between intelligence and happiness, addressing why smarter individuals often report lower life satisfaction.
why_valuable: Challenges common assumptions about intelligence as a predictor of life success and provides psychological insights into human well-being beyond material measures.
